
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /stats                                     │
  │  Learning Statistics                        │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Show learning statistics and deeper learning views.

  Usage:
    /stats
    /stats report
    /stats audit
    /stats prefs
    /stats prompt

  Details:
    Bare /stats shows key learning metrics: tasks completed, success
    rate, errors tracked, feedback received, and tools tracked.
    
    Subactions:
      report — export the full-text learning report
      audit  — audit every learned preference
      prefs  — show learned code style preferences
      prompt — show system prompt size by layer

  Examples:
    $ /stats
    $ /stats prefs
    $ /stats prompt

  Related: /reset  /skill
